source_text: Klagel. Jerem. 3, 7. 8. Ἀφύκτοις με κακοῖς περιβέβληκεν, ἐπιθεὶς τῷ τραχήλῳ μου λαὸν ἀπηνῆ καὶ παραπικραίνοντα καὶ μεῖζον ἢ κατ' ἐμὲ φορτίον. οὐκ εἰσηκούσθην δὲ κουφισθῆναι πολλάκις εὐξάμενος· εἰσακουσθῆναι γὰρ τοὺς ἁγίους ἔσθ' ὅτε κωλύει τὰ πράγματα. λέγοι δ' ἂν ζυγὸν καὶ τοὺς κλοιοὺς τοὺς σιδηροῦς, οὓς ἀντὶ ξυλίνων θεοῦ κε- λεύσει περιεβάλετο, φέρεται γὰρ καὶ γραφή· ἐβάρυνε γὰρ τὸν χαλκὸν τοῦ τραχήλου μου. ἀπέφραξε γὰρ τὴν προσευχήν μου καὶ λέξας αὐτῷ· μὴ προσεύχου περὶ αὐτῶν· οὐ γὰρ εἰσακούσομαί σου<.
pass_a_gloss: He has surrounded me with inescapable evils, having set upon my neck a harsh and embittering people and a burden greater than according to me. And I was not heard to be lightened, though having prayed many times; for circumstances sometimes prevent the holy ones from being heard. And he would also mean a zygos / yoke and the iron collars, which instead of wooden ones by God’s command he put around himself; for a writing is also current: “for he made heavy the bronze of my neck.” For he blocked my prayer also having said to him: “do not pray about them; for I will not hear you.”
pass_b_english: He has surrounded me with inescapable evils, having set upon my neck a harsh and embittering people and a burden greater than according to me. And I was not heard to be lightened, though having prayed many times; for circumstances sometimes prevent the holy ones from being heard. And he would also mean a yoke and the iron collars, which instead of wooden ones by God’s command he put around himself; for a writing is also current: “for he made heavy the bronze of my neck.” For he blocked my prayer also having said to him: “do not pray about them; for I will not hear you.”

choices.why: Lam 3:7 iron collar / yoke of people under divine permission.
